message.content: {"note_claim": "Europeans have long bathed regularly, including saunas/bathhouses in prehistoric and ancient Europe (Iron Age saunas cited).", "label": "SUPPORTS", "quote": "Iron Age saunas, unique to the Castro Culture of northwestern Iberia, have puzzled archaeologists since the nineteenth century. Initially interpreted as kilns, crematoriums, or ovens, their function has since been established as bathing structures", "reason": "The page documents Iron Age bathing/sauna structures in northwestern Iberia (pre-Roman, with Strabo's account of daily bathing), substantiating the note's claim that Europeans built and used bath structures long before the Moors."}

parsed.note_claim: Europeans have long bathed regularly, including saunas/bathhouses in prehistoric and ancient Europe (Iron Age saunas cited).
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: Iron Age saunas, unique to the Castro Culture of northwestern Iberia, have puzzled archaeologists since the nineteenth century. Initially interpreted as kilns, crematoriums, or ovens, their function has since been established as bathing structures
parsed.reason: The page documents Iron Age bathing/sauna structures in northwestern Iberia (pre-Roman, with Strabo's account of daily bathing), substantiating the note's claim that Europeans built and used bath structures long before the Moors.
